scenes.heading: Building recurring content retainers with clients

sents.d: Building recurring content retainers with clients
Recurring work provides more stable income than one-off projects.
Retainer agreements — a set number of pieces per month for an ongoing fee — provide predictable income and reduce the constant effort of finding new one-off projects.

Retainers work best with clients who have an ongoing content need (a regular blog, newsletter, or social content calendar) rather than a single campaign, so identifying which existing clients fit that pattern is a natural starting point.

Pricing a retainer slightly below the equivalent one-off project rate is common, since the trade-off for the client is commitment, and the trade-off for you is predictable, recurring income instead of constantly re-selling your services.

take: Offer monthly retainers to clients who publish regularly.
